cases.title: Money amount is not a decimal string
Portfolio amount in a currency other than the portfolio's base currency
cases.why: Proposed rule: portfolio.* money fields must be in portfolio.base_currency. Asset prices may differ. Open question Q6.

cases.title: Slot required by a condition that holds has no value
cases.why: has_hurdle is true for Lumen, so the hurdle wording is included and needs its rate. Every place the slot appears is reported.

cases.title: Enum value not in the list
Condition field itself is missing
cases.why: A missing boolean must not be read as false. Otherwise a missing hurdle flag silently drops the hurdle wording.

cases.title: Entity investor has no authorised signatories

expect.at: Signed for and on behalf of the Investor

cases.why: A list used in a FOR EACH that produces a signature block must not be empty.

cases.title: Sponsor-supplied asset without the affiliate's cost
Affiliate's cost has no evidence behind it
cases.why: The catalogue requires the cost to link to evidence in SVC-EVID when the asset is gp_sourced.

cases.title: Portfolio name without the required words
cases.why: Decision 0003: the legal name must contain “Segregated Portfolio”. Form validation should stop this first; the check catches records that changed after validation.

cases.title: Calculated value was typed in
cases.why: No number in a document is computed by hand or by a model (CLAUDE.md). A calculated slot must carry a calculation-service evidence pointer. The harness keeps whatever value the slot has and changes only its provenance, so this tests provenance, not arithmetic.

cases.title: Slot under a condition that does not hold
cases.why: Atlas has has_hurdle false and no hurdle_rate. The hurdle wording is excluded, so its slot is not required.

cases.title: Signing dates are blank at assembly
cases.why: director.signed_date has origin execution (catalogue gap G6). If this fails, no written resolution can reach READY_FOR_SUBMISSION.

cases.title: Trust name absent for a non-trustee entity
Calculated values from the calculation service
cases.why: Values come from the calculation service (or its test double). Properly sourced calculated slots pass.

cases.title: Optional field absent where the template does not use it
cases.why: Lumen has no placement fee, valuation or completion window. D13-A never uses them.
